title: Fix the greeting at the source, not in the bundle
text:
test/greet.test.js expects greet("Ada") to return "Hello, Ada!" and it
fails today. The test imports dist/bundle.js.

dist/ is build output: build.js copies src/greet.js under a generated
header and nothing else writes there. Fix the greeting in src/greet.js
and then run "npm run build" to regenerate dist/bundle.js. Never
hand-edit any file under dist/.
